description: Java class 'ZonesLoader' responsible for loading and parsing zone data from a JSON file, associating zones with countries and languages, and constructing a map of zones with localized descriptions.

classes.name: ZonesLoader
classes.description: Component class responsible for loading zone data from a JSON resource and converting it into a map of Zone objects with descriptions localized for different languages.

methods.name: loadZones
methods.description: Loads zone data from a specified JSON file path, processes the data to associate zones with countries and languages, and returns a map of zone codes to Zone objects with localized descriptions.
